svg.title: How the radix tree inserts, splits, matches, locks and evicts
svg.desc: Request B shares S0 to S3 with A. The match stops after four tokens, inside the node, so the node is split into S0 to S3 with slots 1 to 4 and a child a0 a1 with slots 5 and 6. Only slot index tensors are split. B locks the matched node and prefills b0 to b2 into new slots 7 to 9.
svg.text: MATCH ENDS INSIDE THE NODE → SPLIT AT 4
no KV copied by the split
Tree node / KV slot owned by tree
